mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pets (user_id, name, species, breed, birth_date, gender, is_neutered, image_url, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{name}, #{species}, #{breed}, #{birthDate}, #{gender}, #{isNeutered}, #{imageUrl}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT pet_id , user_id , name , species , breed , birth_date , gender , is_neutered , image_url , created_at FROM pets WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
